messages.subject: triggering renderPlot without plotOutput
parts:
Hi all,

I would like to force a renderPlot function to run without the need of a plotOutput. To make it a little bit more clear, I do not need to see somewhere the plot that it returns as far as I know it is produced. I just want to run the code inside the function. Is there any way to achieve that? 

Thanks in advance

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: triggering renderPlot without plotOutput
parts:
Are you sure you don't want observe({...}) instead? It should have the same effect.

If there is some reason you HAVE to use renderPlot, then after defining the output$xxx <- renderPlot({...}), you can call outputOptions(output, "xxx", suspendWhenHidden=FALSE).
